sentences.en: The fisherman saved himself by means of a floating board.
sentences.zh: 那个渔夫用一块浮板救了自己。

sentences.en: Turns out that being a fisherman is no easy task.
sentences.zh: 原来当个渔夫并不是件容易的事。

sentences.en: Fisherman Fritz fishes fresh fish, fresh fish fishes fisherman Fritz.
sentences.zh: 渔夫弗里茨捕鱼，新鲜的鱼钓住了渔夫弗里茨。
